description: R84 capability for detached plugin windows: the pinned view needs the event API (listen for a replacement run) and its own window controls; app commands (take/close/detach) are the app's own and need no permission. R91 · every instance is covered — the exact `plugin-detached` (instance one, unchanged from R84) plus the `plugin-detached-*` glob for instances two and up. R133 · pruned to two: `core:default` already carries the event set, and closing a detached window goes through the `close_plugin_window` command (DetachedPluginApp.tsx:214 → Rust lib.rs:1475), so the window-close grant had no caller.
